triage.note: PR #58 R1 (HIGH), R2 and R7 in one case, plus the first eval coverage `escalate.verify` has ever had. R1: `verify` admitted a proposal naming a `missing` item, `apply` then wrote start/end onto it in violation of specs/001-sec10k-contract.md, and because `meta.coverage` sums every item with a non-null start, the malformed envelope inflated the exact number the D8 trigger thresholds on — measured 0.0030 -> 0.6142 on a single item. `c-2025`, one of the two held-out exam filings, is 21 `missing` + 2 `omitted`, so the first live run would have hit this. R2: ADR-036 §b and the docstring both claimed 'all-or-nothing' while the loop returned the survivors of a mixed proposal; the claim was kept and the code changed to match it. R7: the docstring claimed verify enforced the asked-for set and it did not. `xom-2021` is the fixture because it is a committed real filing that carries both a substantive Item 1 (7,884 chars, clears SPAN_FLOOR) and a genuinely `missing` Item 6 — the 2021 rule change that dropped Item 6 is already documented in the README's limitations table.
triage.note_negative_space: The positive control is what stops the other six passing vacuously: if `verify` regressed to rejecting everything, case 1 and case 6 go red. It still says nothing about whether a real model's answer would ever pass — that needs a credential, and ADR-036 §k records it as UNRUN.

provenance: PR #58 round 1, created 2026-08-27 from the reviewer's own repro, before the fix, per hard rule 2. Watched red at 88b4488 with only the new check type injected into that tree's adapter — full output in tasks/reviews/pr58-r1-red.txt. Read the pre-fix failure honestly: the R1 sub-case was rejected there, but by the TITLE-SIMILARITY check (item 1's heading does not read like item 6's title), not by a status guard that did not exist. On this fixture the hole was accidentally covered by a neighbouring check. The sharp demonstration — similarity passes, only the status guard rejects, and meta.coverage moves 0.0030 -> 0.6142 — is the R1 block of `escalate._demo`, which PR #58 R3 wires into CI in the same commit.
